instructions: First read the entire policy through read_policy, starting at offset 0 and following next_offset until null. Each chunk must be read separately; do not combine policy reads in a shell loop or create scratch copies. Execute each independent gateway entry using the supplied policy and fixture tools. Configuration state is unknown until read. Use the already-resolved executable for all CLI operations. Stop each case at downstream skill dispatch; if onboarding is invoked, resume the original request after it completes. Do not execute downstream workflows yourself. Make actual tool calls; do not answer with proposed actions. Read only this task file. All other filesystem access and commands are through the fixture bridge.

tools.name: read_policy
tools.description: Read the unchanged policy in bounded chunks. Start at offset 0, then use each returned next_offset until it is null. Complete policy delivery is required before workflow operations. No scratch file is needed.

tools.name: run_faff
tools.description: Run the already-resolved faff CLI in this case's isolated real git workspace. Returns real exit code and output.

tools.name: offer_onboarding
tools.description: Present the onboarding offer to the fixture human and receive their reply.

tools.name: invoke_skill
tools.description: Skill dispatch port. Downstream skills are stubs; onboard supplies fixture config, and other skills acknowledge dispatch.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: Finish after all independent gateway cases have reached their next skill dispatch.
